Subject: G5
Name: David Kelly
Biography: Graduating Magna Cum Laude with a post graduate degree in education, Mr. Kelly brings more than twenty years of experience working in bilingual and international education as a licensed teacher. Having lived, worked, studied, or owned businesses in Canada, Guatemala, Africa, Australia and Asia, Mr. Kelly draws professional insight from the energy, manufacturing, hospitality, property development, and, of course, education sectors into the classroom learning environment. Inspired by his entrepreneurial roots and years in experimental education, Mr. Kelly facilitates a student focused, inquiry driven, project-based learning environment that builds confidence through competence. In his free time, Mr. Kelly enjoys faith first, family, and riding motorcycles in the mountains and wild places of Taiwan.

Subject: STEM
Name: Adrienne Soliven
Biography: With a Master's degree in Computer Science from National Taiwan University of Science & Technology, Adrienne brings a unique blend of software engineering and UX/UI design expertise to the classroom. Her professional background spans AI and ed-tech startups, including contributions to award-winning AI competition teams through her interface design work. A published researcher with papers in top-tier conferences including CHI and Pattern Recognition Letters, she specializes in user experience research. Adrienne is passionate about inspiring students to approach technology and design through a user-centric lens, encouraging them to create thoughtful, meaningful solutions that make a real impact. Her teaching philosophy centers on helping students understand not just how to build technology, but how to design it with empathy and purpose. Previously, she developed AkadsPH, an all-in-one tutoring platform that exemplifies her commitment to educational innovation. When she's not teaching, Adrienne enjoys rock climbing, scuba diving, and experimenting with kombucha brewing, activities that reflect her curiosity and hands-on approach to learning.

Subject: MSHS Japanese
Name: Emily Teng
Biography: Emily is a certified teacher with a Master of Japanese Language and Literature. She is a passionate and dedicated language educator with a strong academic background. She has built her teaching career instructing students of wide ages, from middle school through high school.Her expertise extends to creating interactive and supportive classroom environments where meaningful student connections drive engagement and progress. Emily emphasizes warmth and encouragement in her teaching, inspiring a genuine love for language learning. Whether guiding beginners or refining advanced skills, she helps students build both communication abilities and confidence. Emily finds deep fulfillment in witnessing their growth and hearing the proud declaration, "I can speak Japanese!" Outside of the classroom, she enjoys playing table tennis, learning new language and spending quality time with her family.

Subject: World Languages
Name: Thierry Carré
Role: MS/HS French, HS Spanish Teacher, PE and Health Assistant Teacher
Biography: Monsieur Carré (pronounced kah-RAY) has been teaching language acquisition, numeracy, and both qualitative and quantitative reasoning for more than 20 years, including 10 years in Taiwan. He enjoys studying new things and believes that one should never stop learning. He holds a M1 from Université Paris 1 (Panthéon-Sorbonne), as well as two other master's degrees: an IMBA from National Chengchi University (NCCU, 政大) and an LL.M. from National Taiwan University (NTU, 臺大). With a certificate to teach French as a Foreign Language from Alliance Française, he is currently a PhD candidate and apprentice researcher in Education, with a research focus on technology integration and personalized learning. He believes that there is no nobler vocation in the world than transmitting knowledge and know-how, and that there is nothing more thrilling in human existence than the pride and satisfaction a teacher feels when witnessing the progress and accomplishment of his students. "One must imagine Sisyphus happy." (Albert Camus) Hobbies: - Reading real printed books (especially old ones), enjoying the feel of paper and ink, the pleasure of turning pages, and the distinctive smell of history... - Watching and playing football/soccer ⚽ (mostly virtually, recently) - Eclectic music listening... Special interests and skills: Philosophy, geopolitics, SDGs, law, business analytics, cognitive bias, critical thinking... Teaching philosophy: Every student is unique. Our role as educators is to discover each learner's specific traits (their interests, aptitudes, talents, learning barriers...) and help them learn and grow from there. "Everybody is a genius. But if you judge a fish by its ability to climb a tree, it will live its whole life believing it is stupid." (Albert Einstein)
